31508-euthenics-the-science-of-controlla.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Euthenics precedes eugenics, developing better men now, and thus inevitably creating a better race of men in the future. Euthenics is the term proposed for the preliminary science on which Eugenics must be based.

arxiv-1902-04574.title: Machine Reading Comprehension for Answer Re-Ranking in Customer Support Chatbots
arxiv-1902-04574.creator: Momchil Hardalov, Ivan Koychev, Preslav Nakov
arxiv-1902-04574.description: Abstract Recent advances in deep neural networks, language modeling and language generation have introduced new ideas to the field of conversational agents. As a result, deep neural models such as sequence-to-sequence, memory networks, and the Transformer have become key ingredients of state-of-the-art dialog systems.

arxiv-2103-15309.title: Robust Feedback Motion Policy Design Using Reinforcement Learning on a 3D Digit Bipedal Robot
arxiv-2103-15309.creator: Guillermo A. Castillo, Bowen Weng, Wei Zhang, Ayonga Hereid
arxiv-2103-15309.description: Abstract In this paper, a hierarchical and robust framework for learning bipedal locomotion is presented and successfully implemented on the 3D biped robot Digit built by Agility Robotics. We propose a cascade-structure controller that combines the learning process with intuitive feedback regulations.

arxiv-2109-02831.title: Two-flavor color superconductivity in the Fierz-transfromed Nambu − - Jona-Lasinio model
arxiv-2109-02831.creator: Wen-Hua Cai, Qing-Wu Wang
arxiv-2109-02831.description: Abstract The color superconducting phase of two-flavor quark matter is studied under a Fierz-transformed Lagrangian. In the Fierz-transformed Lagrangian both the quark-antiquark and quark-quark channel are included. Two parameters α \alpha and β \beta are introduced to weight the Fierz-transformed quark-antiquark Lagrangian and quark-quark Lagrangian, respectively.

arxiv-2207-06690.title: Contributions of rotation, expansion and line broadening to the morphology and kinematics of the inner CSE of oxygen-rich AGB star R Hya
arxiv-2207-06690.creator: Pham Tuyet Nhung, Do Thi Hoai, Pierre Darriulat, Pham Ngoc Diep, Nguyen Bich Ngoc, Tran Thi Thai, Pham Tuan-Anh
arxiv-2207-06690.description: Abstract We use archival ALMA observations of the CO(2-1) and SiO(5-4) molecular line emissions of AGB star R Hya to illustrate the relative contributions of rotation, expansion and line broadening to the morphology and kinematics of the circumstellar envelope (CSE) within some ∼ \sim 70 au ( ∼ \sim 0.5 arcsec) from the centre of the star.

arxiv-2303-06668.title: An axiomatization of matroids and oriented matroids as conditional independence models
arxiv-2303-06668.creator: Xiangying Chen
arxiv-2303-06668.description: Abstract . Matroids and semigraphoids are discrete structures abstracting and generalizing linear independence among vectors and conditional independence among random variables, respectively. Despite the different nature of conditional independence from linear independence, deep connections between these two areas are found and still undergoing active research.

arxiv-2405-08902.title: Minimization of Dirichlet energy of j − j- degree mappings between annuli
arxiv-2405-08902.creator: David Kalaj
arxiv-2405-08902.description: Abstract . Let 𝔸 \mathbb{A} and 𝔹 \mathbb{B} be circular annuli in the complex plane and consider the Dirichlet energy integral of j − j- degree mappings between 𝔸 \mathbb{A} and 𝔹 \mathbb{B} . Then we minimize this energy integral. The minimizer is a j − j- degree harmonic mapping between annuli 𝔸 \mathbb{A} and 𝔹 \mathbb{B} provided it exits.

arxiv-2412-05488.title: Enhancing Sample Generation of Diffusion Models using Noise Level Correction
arxiv-2412-05488.creator: Abulikemu Abuduweili abulikea@andrew.cmu.edu, Chenyang Yuan chenyang.yuan@tri.global, Changliu Liu cliu6@andrew.cmu.edu, Frank Permenter frank.permenter@tri.global
arxiv-2412-05488.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Abulikemu Abuduweili abulikea@andrew.cmu.edu, Chenyang Yuan chenyang.yuan@tri.global, Changliu Liu cliu6@andrew.cmu.edu, Frank Permenter frank.permenter@tri.global. The denoising process of diffusion models can be interpreted as an approximate projection of noisy samples onto the data manifold. Moreover, the noise level in these samples approximates their distance to the underlying manifold. Building on this insight, we propose a novel method to enhance sample generation by aligning the estimated noise level with the true distance of noisy samples to the manifold.

pmc-11509577.title: Influence of the Pulse Mode of Manual Metal Arc Welding on Weldment Distortions
pmc-11509577.creator: Nikolay Ferdinandov, Danail Gospodinov, Mariana Ilieva, Rossen Radev, Georgi Hristov, Chih-Chun Hsieh, Shinichi Tashiro
pmc-11509577.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). As a result of the thermo-mechanical impact during welding, distortions are generated in welded structures. These distortions significantly influence the geometric and dimensional accuracy of welded structures, in many cases lowering their working characteristics and reliability. An optimal design for welded structures is a prerequisite for increased reliability and reduction in manufacturing cost, and such an optimal design can be achieved knowing the distortions in weldments.

pmc-11540505.title: Deep Neural Network and Radiomics-based Magnetic Resonance Imaging System for Predicting Microvascular Invasion in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-11540505.creator: Zhao-Yi Lin, Kuang Chen, Jia-Rui Chen, Wei-Xiang Chen, Jin-Feng Li, Cheng-Gang Li, Guo-Quan Song, Yan-Zhe Liu, Jin Wang, Rong Liu, Ming-Gen Hu
pmc-11540505.description: Background: Accurate preoperative evaluation of microvascular invasion (MVI) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is crucial for surgeons to make informed decisions regarding appropriate treatment strategies. However, it continues to pose a significant challenge for radiologists. The integration of computer-aided diagnosis utilizing deep learning technology emerges as a promising approach to enhance the prediction accuracy.

pmc-12007548.title: Separable processes for live “in-person” and live “zoom-like” faces
pmc-12007548.creator: Nan Zhao, Xian Zhang, J. Adam Noah, Mark Tiede, Joy Hirsch
pmc-12007548.description: It has long been understood that the ventral visual stream of the human brain processes features of simulated human faces. Recently, specificity for real and interactive faces has been reported in lateral and dorsal visual streams, raising new questions regarding neural coding of interactive faces and lateral and dorsal face-processing mechanisms.

pmc-12381756.title: Left paraduodenal hernia, a diagnostic challenge
pmc-12381756.creator: Evelyne Wassef, Maher Al-Khaldi, François Dagbert, Éric De Broux, Marianne Gagnon-Konamna, Rasmy Loungnarath, Richard Ratelle, Carole Richard, Frank Schwenter, Ramses Wassef, Herawaty Sebajang
pmc-12381756.description: Left paraduodenal hernias, an abnormal protrusion of abdominal organs through a peritoneal defect into the fossa of Landzert, are a rare cause of small bowel obstruction. We present the case of a 21-year-old man with intermittent abdominal pain over several months. Diagnostic laparoscopy confirmed a left paraduodenal hernia.

pmc-12428172.title: Global Research Trends on Nanoplastics in Food: A Bibliometric Analysis of Human Health Concerns
pmc-12428172.creator: Suriyakala Gunasekaran, Sathiyaraj Sivaji, Kayeen Vadakkan, San Yoon Nwe, Sanith Sri Jayashan, Suchada Sukrong
pmc-12428172.description: The increasing prevalence of nanoplastics (NPs) in food and their potential implications for human health have become a growing concern in scientific and public health discourse. Using the Scopus database, this bibliometric analysis provides a comprehensive overview of global research trends on NPs in food from 2015 to 2024. Results show a significant increase in publications and citations post-2019.

pmc-12452735.title: Auditory Processing and Speech Sound Disorders: Behavioral and Electrophysiological Findings
pmc-12452735.creator: Konstantinos Drosos, Paris Vogazianos, Dionysios Tafiadis, Louiza Voniati, Alexandra Papanicolaou, Klea Panayidou, Chryssoula Thodi, Yang Zhang, Giacinto Asprella Libonati
pmc-12452735.description: Background: Children diagnosed with Speech Sound Disorders (SSDs) encounter difficulties in speech perception, especially when listening in the presence of background noise. Recommended protocols for auditory processing evaluation include behavioral linguistic and speech processing tests, as well as objective electrophysiological measures.

pmc-12506795.title: In vitro Activity of the Novel Tetracyclines Derivative, Zifanocycline Against Mycobacterium abscessus
pmc-12506795.creator: Qinlong Yu, Xiaoqin Niu, Bailong Hou, Minjie Mao, Li Zhu, Weifeng Shen, Wei Wang
pmc-12506795.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the in vitro antibacterial activity of zifanocycline against Mycobacterium abscessus.MethodsFrom 2019 to 2024, Mycobacterium abscessus isolates from the respiratory tract of patients were collected at a tertiary hospital in Jiaxing City. All isolates were identified for species, subtypes, and the erm 41 gene polymorphism using whole-genome sequencing (WGS).

pmc-12767442.title: Clove Essential Oil Enhances Antioxidant Defenses and Reduces DNA Damage in a Cellular Model of Parkinson’s Disease
pmc-12767442.creator: Dhouha Hamdi, Omar Ouachik, Ayhan Kocer, Lemlih Ouchchane, Chokri Messaoud, Aziz Hafidi
pmc-12767442.description: Oxidative stress is a major contributor to the pathogenesis of Parkinson’s disease, promoting neuronal degeneration through the production of excessive reactive oxygen species. In this context, natural products such as essential oils are attracting increasing attention for their potential to protect neurons.

pmc-13078226.title: Unveiling the potential of banana (Musa spp.) improvement through genetic manipulation: current trends and future implications
pmc-13078226.creator: Utpal Das, Shiva Sai Prasad, Tanushree Sahoo, Sourav Paramanik, Amrita Halder, Poonguzhali S.
pmc-13078226.description: Banana (Musa spp.) is a globally important fruit crop and a staple food for millions of people. However, its narrow genetic diversity and clonal propagation make it highly vulnerable to pests, diseases, and abiotic stresses. Genetic improvement is limited by sterility, and triploid plants are reproduced clonally in most cultivated varieties, preventing traditional breeding based on genetic advancements.

pmc-13238659.description: BackgroundWe aimed to assess the abundance, distribution, and prognostic significance of Foxp3+ and CD4+ T‐cells and their ratio in primary colorectal cancer (pCRC) and liver metastases (LM) in patients with synchronous and metachronous disease.MethodsWe performed a retrospective study involving patients who underwent resections of both pCRC and either synchronous (N = 55) or metachronous LM (N = 44).

pmc-13297159.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Adults with ADHD showed markedly elevated emotional dysregulation (DERS total M = 115.02).Combined ADHD presentation was associated with significantly higher dysregulation than inattentive presentation.Current SUD, current ADHD symptoms, retrospective childhood ADHD symptoms, trait anxiety, and ADHD-related quality of life were independently associated with DERS total score.

pmc-13458303.creator: Lucy Hyam, Lucy Gallagher, Carina Kuehne, Melissa-Claire Daugelat, Melissa J. Pehlivan, Regan Mills, Karina L. Allen, Ulrike Schmidt
pmc-13458303.description: BackgroundThere has been growing interest in developing a clinical staging model for eating disorders (EDs).
